Research chỉ `RESOLVED` khi câu hỏi đã có kết luận, confidence, limitation, owner và decision handoff. Research chưa resolved không được dùng như quyết định cuối.
## Research quality checklist

- [ ] Question, decision boundary, scope and close condition are explicit.
- [ ] Sources have version/date, method, claim and reliability limitation.
- [ ] Facts, assumptions, recommendation and uncertainty are separated.
- [ ] Alternatives/trade-offs and rejected options are recorded.
- [ ] ROADMAP/SRS/Architecture/decision impact is identified.
- [ ] Owner, next action, due date and resolution status are updated.
